Elaine: Heads-up: after enabling FP8 KV on long-context runs, we're seeing small but reproducible decode degradation + tail latency jitter. 2-token dropouts on ~1% of requests. Profile shows kernel_selector flipping between int8_conv and fp8_matmul mid-decode. Anyone seen this pattern?
Matt: Yup. I think the kernel-selection heuristic uses avg_seq_len and a simple perf table; it doesn't account for current KV cache density or batching hysteresis. Snippet of heuristic config I tried:
```
kernel_selection:
  policy: latency_cost
  seq_length_threshold: 1024
  seq_length_hysteresis_ms: 8
  prefer_quantized_when_memory_saving_pct: 10
```
Try bumping hysteresis and adding cache-aware scoring (score += kv_density * 0.5).
Anya: Also noticed KV hitrate drops ~3% when using INT8 KV vs FP8 on our long-chat workload — maybe quantization noise shifts token embeddings slightly so cached keys don't match exactly when we cache pointers? Quick repro: `./run_profiler --model gpt-xl --kv-mode=int8 --batching=dynamic --trace=kvcache`
perf-bot: profile 1795234511-01 completed: flamegraph at https://internal.artifacts/redwood/profiles/1795234511/flame.svg (sampled) — p95 shows ~12ms jump where kernel switch happens.
Sam: We should run across p4d and g5 to check kernel performance variance. Matt, can you run with `--batching=opportunistic --kernel-hysteresis=12`? I'll set up a ramp test with varying seq length distribution.
Elaine: SG. Assigning to @Matt to root cause and prepare a canary rollback plan. Add a quick smoke that checks decode token fidelity and kv hitrate before accepting FP8 KV. :thumbsup:
